meta.title: Subscribe to push (entity-scoped)
meta.description: Portal user opts in; subscription stored with entityId for scoped notifications.

flow.name: saveSubscription
flow.comment: Use your connection and table. Map fields from pushPrepare via data picker.

notes: Browser subscribe page must POST subscription JSON from PushManager.subscribe().
Expose VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY to the page (env or a small read-only API).
Register a service worker that handles push and notificationclick.
